coordinate_definition: Projections on the outward normals of motor faces M1, M2, M3; body center is origin. This is not an assertion about IMU signs or handedness.
support_evidence: User: intersection of M1 and M2 faces, end away from M3; mainboard opposite M2.
battery_evidence: User: very light, outside along the M1 rotation axis; mass and exact COM position unknown.
mass_limitations: Annuli estimate excludes spokes/fasteners/rotor; total mass and component centers are unmeasured. Static suspension does not need these masses.

observation_format.point_motor_face_mm: Known suspension corner, e.g. [35,35,35]; use the actual attachment point
observation_format.gravity_up_imu: Averaged normalized accelerometer direction while freely suspended, stationary, motors disabled and cables slack
